title: Hypercontractivity for the noise operator
statement: Let $n\ge 0$, let $p,q,\rho\in\mathbb{R}$ satisfy $1\le p\le 2\le q$ and $0\le\rho\le\sqrt{(p-1)/(q-1)}$, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube $\{\pm1\}^n$. Then the uniform $L^q$ norm of the noise operator with parameter $\rho$ applied to $f$ is at most the uniform $L^p$ norm of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: Real-valued function on the sign cube
